purpose: Bind every measured crew-performance observation to a predeclared mission, crew assignment, task, real runtime and immutable receipt.

runtime_gate.steps_executed: >0 for ACCEPT or REJECT runtime evidence
runtime_gate.receipt: emitted after runtime from observed return code and hashes

rex_gate.preflight: mandatory checklist against active REX ledger before task execution
rex_gate.postflight: mandatory recurrence/resolution update after task execution
rex_gate.persistent_rex: may veto allocation, promotion or CONTROL until preventive action is verified

competency_observation.accepted_task: one observation of demonstrated performance at the predeclared task level; not a promotion
competency_observation.rejected_task: failure/rework signal; cannot increase demonstrated level
competency_observation.cross_run_repeat: required for allocation confidence and promotion eligibility
